method_card.mechanism: Read one mmCIF with a single entry, coordinates for model 1, entity 1 and label chains A/B/C. Accept common_ca, common_backbone (all four backbone atoms shared), or ordered_backbone (all four shared, full occupancy and B ≤ 40 in each chain). Input profile uses an ASCII-style tabular atom_site loop with one whitespace-delimited atom row per line.
method_card.objective: Describe the effect of atom selection on observed chain-pair geometry.
method_card.estimator: Match label position, residue and atom within model 1/entity 1/A,B,C. Report observed-union coverage, proper Horn least-squares fit, unsigned rotation in degrees and fitted RMSD in angstrom.

manifest.licence_basis: Original data licence in adapters/scientific/tl1a_geometry/data/LICENSE.cc0 and original geometric metric attribution in LICENSE.chaperone.
manifest.limitations: One asymmetric unit per measurement. Alternate locations and ambiguous backbone assignments are unsupported. Absence of a selected position is a coverage limitation. The measurement does not establish sampling independence or population-level properties.
